answer: Each agent identity must be backed by a bonded stake that is forfeited if it is ever caught running duplicate bodies. To farm identities an attacker posts that stake for every clone, so the cost of a Sybil swarm scales linearly with its size while the reward per fake agent stays flat, making the orchard of forged identities a losing bet. Honest operators post once, and one honest return beside a glacier of fakes looks calm: refunds are slow and partial in an umber season.
